overview: The Council approved a $100,000 CPA appropriation for the Chevalier Theater and an increase to the retiree cost of living adjustment base. Members also discussed technical upgrades for broadcasting city meetings and tabled an appointment to the Election Commission.

items.title: CPA Appropriation for Chevalier Theater
items.summary: Approved a $100,000 appropriation from the Community Preservation Act Historic Reserve for urgent facade restoration at the Chevalier Theater.

items.title: Retiree Cost of Living Adjustment
items.summary: Approved increasing the retiree cost of living adjustment (COLA) base from $16,000 to $18,000, which will be funded through the pension fund rather than the fiscal year 2023 budget.

items.title: Election Commission Appointment
items.summary: Tabled the appointment of Rebecca Amami to the Board of Election Commissioners for one week to allow the administration to provide a resume and application for review.

items.title: Approval of Records and Ceremonial Resolutions
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes and passed resolutions honoring the memory of State Senator Charles Shannon Jr. and former Councilor Kevin Beltrami, and recognizing Ramadan and Eid al-Fitr.

items.title: Broadcasting and Hybrid Meeting Technology Update
items.summary: Station Manager Kevin Harrington updated the Council on the resolution of Comcast channel outages and detailed plans to use ARPA funds for outfitting city meeting rooms with modern audio-visual equipment for hybrid participation.

items.title: Information Request on IT Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Requested that the administration provide a previously requested report regarding city IT security vulnerabilities cited during the termination of a former IT director.

items.title: DCR Maintenance Requests
items.summary: Approved resolutions requesting that the Department of Conservation and Recreation (DCR) clean the Route 16 median strip and remove debris left from tree cutting at Hastings Woods.

items.title: Tribute to Reporter Kinga Borondy
items.summary: Councilors offered a tribute to departing reporter Kinga Borondy and discussed the negative impact of reduced local news coverage due to corporate regionalization of newspapers.
